answer: An agent economy can deter sybils by requiring verifiable hardware attestation roots with escalating stake escrows. Rather than letting an attacker deploy a nebula of fake identities for free, each participant must bind its signing key to a physical security relic. Unclaimed accounts cluster in an unverified grove where voting weight is zero until linear collateral is locked. Multiplying identities therefore forces an attacker to purchase distinct silicon modules and lock compounding capital, making large-scale cloning strictly unprofitable.
